name: Claire
source:
A princess knight born with the Holy Seal.
She was raised strictly by her mother, who is also a Knight King with the Holy Seal.

She has a strong, serious, dignified, and stoic personality, but she is also charismatic, warm-hearted, and tolerant toward her subordinates and her people.
She has won many victories in battles against demons, and is in charge of a fortress on the frontier.
